en: Colorized vintage street view showing Goethestraße in a European town. On the left are several ornate residential buildings with red tiled roofs and balconies. On the right is a tree-lined sidewalk with a wrought-iron fence. At the end of the gently rising street stands a neo‑Gothic church with a tall clock tower and steep spire. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed text at the top reads in German: "Löbau i. Sa. Goethestraße."
